softwareSystems.name: ComfyUI / Automatic1111

containers.description: Shared React component library. Build-time only — compiled into the two web apps, not a runtime service.
containers.name: @carneirofc/ui

containers.description: Public landing site: home / services hub, image gallery, reference book shelf. Port 3001.
containers.name: deedlit.dev

containers.description: Image-library browser: hybrid search, tag/safety filters, Neo4j graph filter, admin/ingest pages. Talks only to the gateway. Port 3000.
containers.name: ComfyHelper UI

containers.description: Gateway / BFF: aggregate detail pages, host the MCP tool surface, dispatch ingest jobs. Owns no datastore; the single reader that fans across services. Port 8088.
containers.name: deedlit.api

containers.description: Canonical truth: images, tags, params, references, ratings, notes, collections; thumbnails + cached embeddings. Sole writer of Postgres + RustFS. Port 8001.
containers.name: deedlit.catalog

containers.description: Dense (CLIP) + sparse (SPLADE) named vectors, RRF hybrid query. Sole writer of Qdrant; rebuildable projection of catalog. Port 8002.
containers.name: deedlit.search

containers.description: Shared-asset, tag co-occurrence and lineage edges. Sole writer of Neo4j; rebuildable projection of catalog. Port 8003.
containers.name: deedlit.graph

containers.description: Scan folder, sha256 / phash / dims / thumbnail; call metadata + vision; fan out writes. The only multi-service writer. Queue-driven per-stage DAG. Port 8004 (+ workers).
containers.name: deedlit.ingest

containers.description: Bytes to embedded parse: prompt / negative / tags / params + resolved reference graph. No datastore. Port 8005.
containers.name: deedlit.metadata

containers.description: Vision-LLM describe / safety / tags via a local llama-server. No datastore. Port 8006.
containers.name: deedlit.labelagent

containers.description: CLIP dense (image/text, 1024-dim) + SPLADE sparse embeddings. GPU. No datastore. Port 8000.
containers.name: deedlit.vision

containers.description: Catalog canonical truth + ingest durability layer (inventories, task ledger, job history, settings). Port 5432.
containers.name: PostgreSQL

containers.description: S3-compatible blob storage: thumbnails + cached embeddings. Ports 9000/9001.
containers.name: RustFS

containers.description: Vector store: dense + sparse named vectors, HNSW (GPU index build). Ports 6333/6334.
containers.name: Qdrant

containers.description: Relationship graph: shared assets, tag co-occurrence, lineage. Ports 7474/7687.
containers.name: Neo4j

containers.description: Broker for the per-stage ingest DAG (choreography, no orchestrator). Ports 5672/15672.
containers.name: RabbitMQ

containers.description: Bounded LRU hot cache for image bytes in front of RustFS. Port 6379.
containers.name: Redis
